content:
maya: Quick design Q — should filter state persist/sync when you pin models into the compare view? Right now if you toggle filters in the left rail while compare is open the compare toolbar still shows the old state, which is confusing.

sam: I noticed that too. I assumed the compare modal re-reads active filters on open. Can you paste repro steps?

maya: repro: open Catalog -> select 2 models -> open Compare -> go back to Catalog and toggle ‘gpu: t4’ -> open Compare (or keep open) and toolbar still shows ‘All’ filters. Expected: toolbar reflects applied filters or some clear affordance that it’s a frozen snapshot.

luis: We originally decoupled to avoid accidental refetches while people are iterating in compare. Technically easier to keep it snapshot-based, but UX is arguably misleading.

ara: Product tradeoff: if we auto-sync we might change results under the user, which is bad. If we keep snapshot, users sometimes think filters didn't apply.

june: From research sessions: users interpret a pinned compare as a "snapshot"—they expect it to stay as-is even if they tweak filters. But users also want an obvious way to re-sync when intended.

maya: Proposal: add a small "Sync filters" toggle in the Compare header (default: off). When on we mirror the catalog filter chips into the compare toolbar (no extra network calls unless user triggers a refresh). When off the compare remains a frozen snapshot. Show a tooltip: "Sync filters with catalog (off = snapshot)" :information_source:

sam: Implementation notes: accessible toggle should be a button with aria-pressed. Minimal DOM diff: copy chips into toolbar DOM and keep a boolean sync flag. Keyboard focus must land on toggle. Example button pattern:

```
<button class="compare-sync" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Sync filters with catalog">Sync</button>
```
We also need to announce changes via live region when sync flips.

luis: A11y + visual nits: performance badges are failing contrast on small text — the green pill uses #28c070 on white, which is borderline. Suggest darken background or use 600 weight text + 1px border to hit 4.5:1. Also ensure focus ring is >= 3px visible offset for keyboard users.

maya: Agree on copy: we should use "Pin version" not "Lock version" (friendlier). Badge copy: shorten to "perf · 95ms" rather than long tooltip; detailed metrics in hover panel.

ara: Decision checklist: add Sync toggle (default off), update badge color tokens to accessible variants, change copy to "Pin version", add a small badge tooltip for metrics. Deliverable: design handoff + accessible spec by EOD Friday?

sam: I'll prototype the toggle and badge variables. Plan: add unit tests for keyboard nav + add a11y checks in Percy/Lighthouse. Will ping for review. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: branch created: compare-sync-toggle (for design & FE pairing).

maya: Thanks — I'll update mockups and include the tooltip text and focus states in the spec.
